verdict.rationale: Access control is a fair axis for a database product, but the evidence pack never mentions API keys, roles, RBAC, or per-collection permissions. BYOC single-tenant deployments and multi-tenant scaling are deployment and isolation features, not granular access control on database operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce granular access control (API keys, roles, per-collection permissions) on database operations
